According to Fox News, for anyone who may be wondering if Ricky Gervais plans to host the next Golden Globes, the answer is a resounding no.

Deadline.com also shared information about an avid fan who posted a video of the 2020 Golden Globes with Gervais as the host. The fan asked others to retweet the clip “if you wish [Gervais] would host the Golden Globes again in 2023.” The actor and comedian retweeted the post with a “F--- that” response and a laughing emoji.

At the 2020 Globes, Gervais began the show with a controversial speech that blasted Hollywood’s elite and big tech, according to Fox News.AS CHICAGO BRACES FOR 'ICE INVASION,' DHS SECRETARY NOEM CONFIRMS ITS COMING!

A 2021 interview by Gervais has him talking about his approach to hosting events and how he goes about understanding the audience. The interview with The Guardian reports Gervais saying, “Do I pander to the 200 billionaires in the room or the 200 million people at home in their [underwear] drinking beer who aren’t winning awards, who aren’t billionaires?”DETROIT PRO-PALESTINIAN CONFERENCE SPARKS FURY AFTER SHOCKING CALL TO ‘DESTROY THE IDEA OF AMERICA’

Fox News reported the Hollywood Foreign Press would return in 2023 for the televised event. The 2022 ceremony was not televised and was limited to just a press release. The association has signed with NBC to broadcast the upcoming event.CALIFORNIA SCRAMBLES TO DEPLOY SECURITY FOR KAMALA HARRIS!
